text: {"findings":[{"rule_id":"MF-005","evidence":[{"kind":"note","ref":"N3","page":1,"quote":"HEAT TREATMENT  :-(English) 1) TO BE TOUGHENED UPTO 28-32 HRC. 2) RETAPPING TO BE DONE AFTER SURFACE TREATMENT AT SUPPLIER END.( IF APPLICABLE )"}],"comment":"The heat treatment note specifies the target hardness (28-32 HRC) but does not state at which stage of manufacture it applies (e.g., after rough machining, before surface treatment). Without a defined sequence the supplier may apply it at the wrong point, risking distortion of finished features or damage to the plating. The designer should add the manufacturing stage to the heat treatment callout in N3.","recommended_correction":"Revise N3 to specify when the toughening is to be performed relative to machining and surface treatment, for example 'TO BE TOUGHENED TO 28-32 HRC AFTER ROUGH MACHINING AND BEFORE SURFACE TREATMENT'."}]}
